answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the karst log publishes the live set and the canyon audit records each lapse. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 652 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Keeping 154 aliases alive thus means 154 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the cedar quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. That is 7 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
